nodes.title: MiniMax H3 Ref2VA｜6图通用主节点

widgets_values:
MiniMax H3 Ref2VA｜6图通用加速版

默认参数：16:9 / 1.0MP / 10秒 / Euler / beta / 11步 / Turbo LoRA 0.7 / H3 SageAttention / ref_image_size=max / 原生音频 / H.264 CRF17。

参考槽位：Picture 1=主体A；Picture 2=主体B；Picture 3=主体C；Picture 4=场景；Picture 5=道具1；Picture 6=道具2。
不用的参考槽位请关闭；关闭中间槽位后，请重新确认 Prompt 中 Picture / Subject 的实际编号。
Prompt 只描述当前视频需要发生的内容；参考图用于锁身份、场景与道具，不必锁死姿势、表情和构图。

这是单采生产版：不执行二次采样放大。最终视频请从“最终输出｜H.264 / 24fps / CRF17”下载。
nodes.title: 使用说明｜MiniMax H3 Ref2VA 6图通用加速版

widgets_values:
[Reference Mapping]
<Picture 1> = Subject A
<Picture 2> = Subject B
<Picture 4> = Courtyard gate scene

[Visual Style]
Photorealistic live-action cinematic video, real human proportions, natural skin texture, realistic facial details, realistic hair details, natural evening light, grounded physical motion, no animation look, no cartoon look, no comic style, no extra people, no text, no watermark.

[Scene]
A traditional courtyard gate entrance in the evening. Subject B is moving forward near the gate. Subject A quickly catches up from behind. The environment matches <Picture 4>.

[Character Consistency]
Keep Subject A strictly consistent with <Picture 1>.
Keep Subject B strictly consistent with <Picture 2>.
Do not merge identities.
Do not swap faces.
Both faces must stay stable during motion, turning, pulling, and close-up moments.

[Shot Goal]
Test strong two-person interaction, large body motion, close face detail, and facial stability under movement.
The video must show that the workflow can keep faces clear in close-up and stable during strong motion.

[Action]
Subject B walks quickly past the courtyard gate, trying to leave.
Subject A rushes up from behind and forcefully reaches out to block Subject B at the gate.
Subject B instinctively shakes off the hand with a clear, strong arm motion, then turns back sharply in anger.
Subject A immediately steps in again and grabs Subject B’s wrist, stopping him from leaving.
The two move closer into a tense face-to-face confrontation.
Subject B sharply turns his head and glares at Subject A.
Subject A is breathing hard, emotionally tense but controlled.
Then Subject A leans in closer toward Subject B as the emotional pressure rises.

[Dialogue]
Subject A says clearly and urgently:
“你今天必须把话说清楚。”

[Performance]
Subject A: urgent, breathing slightly heavily, emotionally pressing forward, intense eye contact, controlled anger.
Subject B: resistant, irritated, sharp reaction, angry glare, strong defensive body language.
Both performances must feel realistic and grounded.

[Camera]
Begin with a 35mm two-shot medium close follow shot.
Track the two characters as Subject A catches up and blocks Subject B.
Clearly show the arm block, the wrist grab, and the body distance closing.
Then push in smoothly to a tighter two-shot close-up during the confrontation.
Finally push further to a 50mm close-up on Subject A’s face as he delivers the line and leans forward.
Focus priority stays on the active speaking face, while keeping both faces readable during the two-shot section.

[Motion Requirements]
Large body motion is required: fast catch-up, arm block, arm shake-off, wrist grab, sharp head turn, forward lean.
Camera motion and character motion must both be present.
Motion must remain smooth and physically believable.

[Quality Requirements]
Faces must remain stable and recognizable throughout the video.
No face drift, no face swap, no facial collapse, no hand-face fusion, no body distortion.
Close-up facial detail must stay clear.
Fast motion must not make the faces blurry or unstable.
Two-person interaction must remain coherent and readable.
